alignments.note: Assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12).

Participle rendered by the fixed title Chief Musician. Rule 31's subtraction ties (Chief alone is any chief, Musician alone any musician); the tiebreak is the ASV's own use, and the ASV never writes Musician alone for this word, so Musician is the supplied generic and the head goes on Chief, which writes the superintending lexeme of נצח. Competing head Musician (rule 8).
Supplied indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).
Lamed auctoris to of; ASV reorders it after Song (rule 25).
Supplied a belongs to the noun (rule 15).
